meaning:
§ Beth-anath = "house of response (or affliction)"
a place in Naphtali

elsewhere.note: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land.…
